nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Raw Body is on so the signature can be checked against the exact bytes that were signed. The Code node falls back to rebuilding them if your n8n version does not expose it.

nodes.name: Verify signature
nodes.notes: Throws on a bad or stale signature, which returns a non-2xx. The auth service logs that as email_send_failed.

nodes.name: Send with Gmail
nodes.notes: Connect your Google account here. This is the only place a mail credential exists — the auth service never holds one.

nodes.name: Respond 200
nodes.notes: A 2xx tells the auth service the message was accepted. Anything else is logged as a delivery failure.
